facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Barbaros Bay on the Bodrum peninsula.
facts.excerpt: the most untouched part of the Bodrum peninsula, sprawling on 62.000 square meters of picturesque land on the shores of Barbaros Bay

facts.text: The hotel grounds cover 62.000 square meters.
facts.excerpt: sprawling on 62.000 square meters of picturesque land

facts.text: The hotel is set on the cliffs of Barbaros Bay overlooking the Aegean Sea.
facts.excerpt: a luxury 5-star resort set on the cliffs of pristine Barbaros Bay. Nestled on the stunning cliffs overlooking the azure blue Aegean Sea

facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool.
The hotel has the 5500 sqm Kempinski Wellness & Spa.
facts.excerpt: unwinding at the 5500 sqm Kempinski Wellness & Spa

facts.text: The hotel has a private beach where guests can enjoy water sports.
facts.excerpt: enjoying water sports on the private silent beach

facts.text: The hotel has several restaurants serving global and local cuisines.
facts.excerpt: our diverse restaurants, offering a symphony of flavors inspired by global and local cuisines

facts.text: The hotel has a helipad for arrivals.
facts.excerpt: One-way helipad fee is EUR 450, inclusive of VAT.

facts.text: Bodrum Down Town is about 20 minutes and 15 km from the hotel.
The Castle of St. Peter is about 26 minutes and 16 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Castle of St. Peter: 26 min – 16 km

facts.text: The hotel offers a hotel limo transfer from Milas-Bodrum Airport.
facts.excerpt: By Hotel Limo: From Milas-Bodrum Airport (BJV)

facts.text: Public airport shuttles run from Milas-Bodrum Airport to Bodrum Bus Station, and taxis are available at the terminal exits.
facts.excerpt: Take Havaş or Muttaş airport shuttles located at the exits of the domestic or international terminals.

facts.text: The hotel offers spa treatments and water sports.
facts.excerpt: from rejuvenating spa treatments to thrilling water sports
